## Chapter progress demonstration

Manual only. Demo inputs are synthetic and include separate plans and supplemental timed-paper/timestamp evidence. Rules and thresholds come from student-tracker/config.yaml; regenerate this export after changing them.

Attach a credential for a disposable DEMO Postgres database with the student-tracker schema. No Alcovia API is called. Unknown evidence is reported, not invented. Demo summary shows rejected rows. This does not update live pipeline freshness.
